theater: 河西走廊西端與積石山以北

battle.name: 隋賀婁子干擊吐谷渾之戰
battle.theater: 河西走廊西端與積石山以北
battle.brief: 開皇四年，吐谷渾寇涼州，隋文帝以賀婁子干為行軍元帥，率軍出河西走廊西征，越積石深入青海，追擊伏允牙帳，迫其僅以身免。此役交鋒多在馬上：吐谷渾以長矛騎兵衝突隋軍槊陣，隋軍以強弩壓制、槊手反突。卡面的埃及長矛正是這類長杆矛兵的鼻祖，兩千年後仍在青海的槊矛上留著同一副骨架。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries:
開皇四年（584年），隋與吐谷渾在青海道與河西走廊西端再起兵端。吐谷渾是鮮卑慕容部西遷後建立的游牧政權，五四〇年夸吕建都於伏俟城，即今青海湖東南岸都蘭、共和一帶；可汗伏允控制青海湖周邊草原與柴達木盆地南緣，並以白蘭道橫跨絲路南道，把吐蕃、西域與中原的商旅夾在自己腹心。開皇初年，隋文帝對它一面遣使冊封、加號安撫，一面整軍備邊；吐谷渾表面稱臣，實則時常入寇，掠奪涼州、鄯州、且末一線的邊民與牲畜，也讓河西走廊的商隊屢屢改道。

隋朝一方是剛建立四年的新朝：行軍元帥上柱國賀婁子干，涼州總管，節制武威郡公宇文欣、河間郡王李諳等部，兵自武威沿河西走廊西出，關隴精騎為先鋒，涼州邊軍與新募步卒繼之，糧秣自關中與涼州、鄯州倉儲轉運，車隊、騾馬、腳夫排成長線。吐谷渾一方則是可汗居中、諸王分牧的族帳體制：兵以騎兵為絕對主力，步卒多來自屬戶、奴婢與附庸部眾，弓箭與長矛靠漢地、西域的市易補充，戰力靠劫掠維持，內部靠各部族的分贓與歸附維持鬆散的合作。
countriesEn:
In the fourth year of Kaihuang (584), Sui and Tuyuhun went to war once more along the Qinghai road and the western end of the Hexi Corridor. Tuyuhun was a nomadic polity built by the Xianbei Murong clan after its westward migration; in 540 the ruler Kualü founded the capital of Fusi city, on the eastern shore of Qinghai Lake in what are now the Dulan and Gonghe counties. The khan Fuyun controlled the pastures around the lake and the southern rim of the Qaidam basin, and straddled the southern branch of the Silk Road along the Bailan route, sitting astride the trade between Tibet, the Western Regions and the Chinese heartland. In the early Kaihuang years the Sui emperor Yang Jian sent envoys to invest Fuyun with a title and to keep him pacified, while at the same time building up the frontier garrisons; Tuyuhun pretended to be a vassal but raided again and again, carrying off border people and livestock from Liangzhou, Shanzhou and Qiemo, and forcing the merchants of the Hexi Corridor to change their routes.

The Sui side was a new dynasty only four years old. The supreme commander, the upper pillar general He-lou Zi-gan, governor of Liangzhou, held the armies of the Duke of Wuwei Yu-wen Xin and the Prince of Hejian Li An, and marched west from Wuwei along the Hexi Corridor. Elite cavalry from the Guanlong region led the way, frontier troops of Liangzhou and newly recruited infantry followed, and the grain was shifted from the depots of Guanzhong, Liangzhou and Shanzhou by cart, mule and porter, the whole column strung out along the road. The Tuyuhun side was a confederation of tents: the khan in the centre, the princes each pasturing their own herds. Cavalry was overwhelmingly the main force, the infantry drawn from dependent households, bondsmen and subordinate tribes; bows, arrows and long spears were bought in the markets of Han China and the Western Regions, and the army was kept alive by plunder, with loose cooperation held together by the division of loot and by the defection of smaller groups.
people:
這一役的關鍵人物，隋方是賀婁子干。他字孝仁，蒲州安邑人，父賀婁整為周大將軍，是關隴軍事世家出身；他以治軍嚴整、敢於深入著稱，開皇四年被隋文帝任為行軍元帥，節制河西各軍，專責討平吐谷渾。與他並肩的是武威郡公宇文欣與河間郡王李諳，都是隋初開國舊將，分領本部隨征。皇帝隋文帝楊堅本人沒有臨陣，卻在幕後決定了戰役的時機：開皇年間北邊初定、南朝陳尚在，他不願在統一之前兩面用兵，於是把西北的戰事壓在夏秋一線、在涼州囤糧、在關中練騎，待局勢成熟才一次出手。

吐谷渾方面，可汗伏允是這一戰的主角。伏允出自慕容氏汗族，控弦之地廣、馬匹多，自恃遠在塞外、隋軍難以深入的地理屏障，屢次侵擾涼州而不肯真心臣服；此役他只在軍中坐鎮，未能親自衝鋒。可汗的兄弟與諸王各領部眾，分據青海湖周邊牧地，部分人主張對隋硬抗，部分人則趁隋軍深入而圖謀自己的地位，故大潰之後，吐谷渾內部的權力格局也被戰敗重新洗牌。

史載賀婁子干此後仍在隋的西北體系中效力：開皇九年平陳，他再為行軍元帥，進兵陳州，平定高智慧的兵變；陳平之後拜涼州總管，在河西整軍置屯、講武修塞，成為隋朝經營西北歷時最長的一位將領。他在開皇四年的這一役，等於替隋朝把西北邊防的骨架先搭了起來。
peopleEn:
The decisive figure on the Sui side was He-lou Zi-gan. His courtesy name was Xiaoren; he was a native of Anyi in Puzhou, and his father He-lou Zheng had been a general of the Zhou, so he came from a military family of the Guanlong region. He was known for strict discipline and for daring to push deep into enemy country, and in the fourth year of Kaihuang the Sui emperor appointed him supreme commander of the expedition against Tuyuhun, with authority over the armies of the Hexi region and sole responsibility for reducing the enemy. Beside him marched the Duke of Wuwei Yu-wen Xin and the Prince of Hejian Li An, both veteran generals of the early Sui, each leading his own contingent. The emperor Yang Jian himself never came to the field, yet he decided the timing of the campaign from behind the scenes: with the north only just settled and the Chen court still standing in the south, he was unwilling to fight on two fronts before the unification was done, so he compressed the western operations into the summer and autumn, stockpiled grain at Liangzhou and trained the cavalry in Guanzhong, and struck only once the moment was ripe.

On the Tuyuhun side the protagonist was the khan Fuyun. Fuyun belonged to the Murong line of the khaganate, commanded a wide arc of mounted men and owned many horses; trusting to the distance of his pastures beyond the passes and to the difficulty Sui armies would have in reaching him, he harried Liangzhou again and again and never sincerely submitted. In this campaign he stayed in camp and did not lead any charge himself. The khan's brothers and the princes each held their own bands and grazed their own lands around the lake; some of them favoured open resistance to the Sui, while others used the Sui deep inside their country to fish for advantage, so the defeat also reshuffled the balance of power inside Tuyuhun.

The record has him serving on afterwards in the Sui system of the north-west: in the ninth year of Kaihuang, when Chen was destroyed, he was again made supreme commander, marched on Chenzhou and put down the revolt of Gao Zhihui; after Chen fell he was made governor of Liangzhou, where he reorganised the garrison, set up military farms and drilled the troops behind repaired frontier walls, becoming the longest-serving of the Sui commanders on the north-western front. His campaign of 584 had already built the skeleton of the Sui defence of the north-west.
kits:
卡面這件埃及長矛，是早王朝時期的長杆刺擊兵器：銅或青銅矛頭安在木杆上，無論守城垣還是收復失地，都靠成排矛手把尖端送出。放到開皇四年的青海戰場，它的對應物不是青銅而是鐵，形式卻幾乎沒有變——吐谷渾騎兵手中的長矛，正是這類長杆矛兵的草原版本，矛頭為鐵製的菱形或柳葉形，裝在兩丈上下的木杆上，單手可持，也能夾在腋下，衝鋒時以肩臂的力量把矛尖送進人馬的結合部。

隋軍這邊，同樣以長杆兵器為骨架。馬槊與標槊是關隴騎兵的標準裝備，槊桿前段裝鐵刃，後段保留木質，必要時可當短兵使用；步卒則是方盾、楯、長矛與強弩的組合，弩有蹶張、擘張之別，遠射壓制是其長處。防具方面，隋軍有明光鎧、札甲這類南朝已成熟的裝備，吐谷渾騎兵多著皮甲、氈甲，少量鐵鎧，頭戴兜鍪或以毛皮纏額面對刀箭。弓弩兩端都有角弓與鳴鏑，環首刀則是近身格鬥的標準。

兵裝之外，這一戰最吃緊的其實是運輸。隋軍用木車與騾馬運糧，遠出河西之後改為「略糧」自帶，沿途向吐谷渾帳戶索取牛羊，吐谷渾的帳幕、駱駝、氈毯自成一支可以移動的後勤體系，正好是隋軍要對付的目標。這支部隊的技術譜系，最早可以一路追溯到卡面那支三千多年前綁著青銅矛頭的木杆長矛。
kitsEn:
The Egyptian spear on the card is an early dynastic thrusting weapon: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft, used whether to hold a city wall or to recover lost ground, and in both cases it was rows of spearmen who put the point forward. Set in the Qinghai battlefield of the fourth year of Kaihuang, its counterpart is not bronze but iron, yet the shape has barely changed. The long spears of the Tuyuhun cavalry were the steppe version of this same family of long-hafted weapons: iron heads in rhombic or willow-leaf form socketed on shafts of roughly two zhang, light enough to be carried one-handed or tucked under the arm, so that the charge could drive the point into the seam between horse and rider.

The Sui army stood on the same skeleton of long-hafted weapons. The ma shuo and the biao shuo, the lance and the marked lance, were the standard equipment of the Guanlong cavalry, with an iron blade on the front of the shaft and wood left at the rear so that the weapon could be used at close quarters as well. Their infantry were a combination of square shields, pavises, long spears and powerful crossbows, drawn by foot or by braced strength, their strength lying in shooting at range. For protection the Sui had bright armour and lamellar armour, both mature in the southern courts, while the Tuyuhun horsemen wore mostly leather and felt armour with a little iron, and either wore a helmet or wrapped their faces in hide against arrows. Both sides had horn bows and whistling arrows, and the ring-pommel sword was the standard of close combat.

Beyond the weapons themselves, transport was the tight spot of this war. The Sui moved grain in wooden carts and on mules, and once they were far out along the Hexi they carried reduced rations with them and took cattle and sheep from the Tuyuhun camps on the way. The tents, camels and felt rugs of the Tuyuhun formed a mobile logistics system of their own, and it was precisely that system the Sui army was trying to strike. The technical pedigree of this column can be traced back to the wooden shaft with its bronze head carried in Egypt more than three thousand years earlier.
tactics:
隋軍的用兵，帶著北朝以來邊軍的老規矩：不求速勝，先穩住糧道，再逐步向縱深推。兵出武威之後，前鋒以精騎開路，中軍是弩手與槊手混編的步騎大隊，輜重與傷兵隨後；沿途據守關隘、驅逐小股游騎，遇敵則以弩陣封住道路，讓吐谷渾騎兵無法展開衝鋒，然後以步軍的長槊列陣抵住對方的矛尖，等敵騎力竭、陣形散亂時再以騎兵反突。這一役最關鍵的一場接觸發生在鄯州一帶：吐谷渾傾力來攻，把隋軍壓在河谷與城垣之間，隋軍頂住了，隨即整隊西進。

吐谷渾的應手，是草原式的拖延與耗損。遊騎不斷引誘與牽制隋軍，撤退時不惜殺傷自己的牛羊、燒掉帳幕，把能帶走的物資全部帶走，讓隋軍的糧秣越來越薄；伏允本人在主力尚未集結之前就已遠遁，隋軍雖追到他的牙帳，卻因糧道過長、援軍未至而不敢久留，只能按計劃在取得戰果後班師，並在積石山一帶刻石記功。雙方都清楚這一點：這是一場以時間和糧草對賭的遠征，隋朝贏了會戰，卻沒有一舉滅國的餘力。
tacticsEn:
The Sui followed the old frontier practice of the northern dynasties: they did not seek a quick decision, but first stabilised the supply line and then pushed forward by degrees. After leaving Wuwei, an advance of picked cavalry led the way, the centre was a mixed column of crossbowmen and lancers, and the baggage and the wounded followed behind. They held the passes on the route, drove off the small bands of raiding horsemen, and where the enemy appeared they used the crossbow line to close the road so that the Tuyuhun cavalry could not spread out for the charge; the infantry then formed ranks of long spears to hold the enemy's points, and when the enemy horse was spent and the formation had come apart, the Sui cavalry counter-charged. The critical contact of the campaign took place around Shanzhou, where the Tuyuhun brought everything they had against the Sui and pressed them into the river valleys and against the city walls. The Sui held, and then marched west in order.

The Tuyuhun answered in the steppe manner, with delay and attrition. Light horsemen lured and tied down the Sui columns, and when they withdrew they did not hesitate to kill their own cattle and sheep or burn their tents, carrying away everything they could, so that the Sui grain grew thinner with every day. Fuyun himself withdrew far before his main force could concentrate; the Sui pursued him to his camp, but with the supply line over-stretched and no reinforcements in hand they could not stay long, and by the plan they broke up after the victory and carved the record of the campaign into stone around Jishi Mountain. Both sides understood the arithmetic: this was a long-distance expedition gambling on time and fodder. The Sui won the battle of arms, but had no strength left to destroy the state.
data:
先把紀年對齊：開皇四年即公元五八四年，距隋文帝滅陳統一還有五年。地理上，這條戰線從武威（涼州）起，經鄯州（今西寧）西行，再過大積石山進入青海腹地，直抵可汗牙帳所在的伏俟城一線，全程以千里計；其中最遠的追擊路段在積石山以北的河谷與草原間，隋軍的糧隊必須在後方跟進數百里。兵力方面，吐谷渾集眾來攻鄯州的人數，舊史記以十餘萬計；隋軍這邊，《隋書》只記「以行軍元帥將兵討之」，未詳載確數，可確認的是主力為關隴精騎與涼州邊軍，步騎配合，另配大批輜重夫役，遠征的實際作戰人數當遠少於對方游牧政權的全部人口。

戰果的數字諸史不一，較一致的說法是：吐谷渾大潰，伏允僅以身免，其名王被俘，部眾有相當一部分降於隋軍，牲畜被掠走或散失無數。時間線往後：戰後吐谷渾遣使請罪、重新入朝，隋廷恢復其封號；到大業四年（六〇八年），隋遣宇文述再攻吐谷渾，克曼頭、赤水二城，於其地置鄯善、且末、西海、河源四郡；四郡至大業六年前後全沒，伏允在青海復國；此後吐谷渾在隋、唐、吐蕃之間周旋，直到六六三年為吐蕃所滅。
dataEn:
First the dating: the fourth year of Kaihuang is 584 CE, five years before the Sui emperor destroyed Chen and unified the realm. Geographically the line ran from Wuwei (Liangzhou) west through Shanzhou, present-day Xining, and then across the Great Jishi Mountain into the heart of Qinghai, as far as Fusi city where the khan's camp stood, a route measured in thousands of li; the furthest stretch of pursuit lay north of Jishi Mountain among the river valleys and pastures, and the Sui baggage train had to follow several hundred li behind. On numbers of men, the old histories record the Tuyuhun assembling more than a hundred thousand to attack Shanzhou. For the Sui the Sui Shu gives only the formula that the supreme general went out with troops to punish them, and gives no exact figure; what can be confirmed is that the core was elite Guanlong cavalry and the frontier troops of Liangzhou, infantry and cavalry combined, supported by a large body of baggage porters, so the real fighting force on so long a march must have been well below the size of the opposing host.

The figures of the result differ from history to history; the most consistent account is that the Tuyuhun were badly beaten, Fuyun escaped with his life alone, his named princes were captured, a considerable part of his people surrendered to the Sui, and the herds were either carried off or scattered and lost. The timeline after the battle: the Tuyuhun sent envoys to ask forgiveness and returned to court, and the Sui restored their title. In the fourth year of Daye (608) the Sui sent Yu-wen Zhu against them again, took the two cities of Mantou and Chishui, and created the four commanderies of Shanshan, Qiemo, Xihai and Heyuan on that soil; all four were lost within a few years, Fuyun restored his kingdom at Qinghai, and from then on the Tuyuhun manoeuvred between Sui, Tang and Tibet until they were destroyed by the latter in 663.
cause:
打起來的原因有遠有近。近因是開皇四年吐谷渾再次寇掠涼州，邊郡告急，隋廷不得不動手；遠因則是青海道的存廢。吐谷渾扼住白蘭道，就掐住了絲路南道與西域的交通：商隊過境要繳稅、換馬、要保護，吐谷渾靠這筆過境財賦養活自己的部眾，因此它絕不願看隋朝在青海道上站穩腳跟；對隋文帝而言，河西走廊背後多一個不受控的游牧政權，意味著涼州的屯田、邊馬與關中的西征路線都暴露在對方騎兵之下。

更深一層是開皇年間的整體戰略。隋代周而立才三年多，南面陳朝仍在，關中兵馬有限，朝廷既不能容忍涼州年年被掠，又不宜在統一之前耗盡主力，於是把問題壓縮成一次有計劃的、有糧草上限的懲罰性遠征：出兵要快、要準、要讓可汗知道邊界在哪裡，卻不求深入滅國。同時，隋廷對吐谷渾一直採取「先羈縻、後武力」的兩手：遣使冊封、賜帛以安其心，屯兵修塞以備其變，一旦對方越界，便以優勢兵馬一次性壓制。這一役正是這套政策走到武力那一端的第一步。
causeEn:
The reasons for fighting were both immediate and remote. The immediate one was that in the fourth year of Kaihuang the Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou again and the frontier commanderies called for help, so the court had to move. The remote one was the question of the Qinghai road itself. Holding the Bailan route, the Tuyuhun held the throat of the southern branch of the Silk Road: caravans crossing their territory paid tax, changed horses and needed protection, and the Tuyuhun lived on this transit revenue, so they could never accept a Sui foothold on the Qinghai road. For the Sui emperor, a nomadic power beyond the back of the Hexi Corridor meant that the frontier farms, the grazing horses of Liangzhou and the western lines of communication out of Guanzhong were all exposed to hostile horsemen.

Deeper still lay the overall strategy of the Kaihuang years. The Sui had replaced the Zhou barely three years before, the Chen court in the south was still there, and the armies of Guanzhong were limited; the court could not tolerate Liangzhou being stripped every year, and could not afford to exhaust the main body of its forces before the unification, so it compressed the problem into a single punitive expedition with a planned timetable and a fixed ceiling on grain: the army was to move fast, strike accurately and make the khan understand where the frontier lay, without any aim of marching to the end of the country. At the same time the Sui had always pursued a two-handed policy towards the Tuyuhun, pacifying them first by investiture, gifts of silk and goodwill, while stationing troops and repairing the frontier wall against their change of heart; once they crossed the line, the Sui would crush them once and for all with superior numbers. This campaign was the first step of that policy reaching the point of open force.
impact:
這一戰的結果，超出戰場本身。對吐谷渾來說，開皇四年之後它第一次被打到可汗本人落荒，名王被俘、大批部眾散歸草原，內部各部族之間原本靠分贓維持的合作關係被撕裂，權力向少數幾支強部集中，國勢由盛轉衰，此後雖然在青海道上一度重新聚起兵馬，卻再也沒有能力與隋唐正面抗衡，直到被吐蕃吞併。

對隋朝與西域來說，這一役是一次成功的邊境政策示範：河西走廊的商旅與軍資往來安全了，青海道的商稅與貢賦有了可指望的秩序，隋朝的軍威也第一次明確傳到西域，令西突厥與高昌一帶重新估算這個新朝的份量。日後大業年間隋朝敢於在西北同時開闢數條戰線、設立四郡，底子正是開皇年間這幾次得手。軍事技術層面，這一役也把北朝以來邊軍遠征的老毛病擺到桌面：糧道越拉越長，游牧政權的焦土撤退比正面會戰更難應付，隋軍在唐初將軍手中會被更細緻地處理。

更長遠的看，吐谷渾的結局其實是整個青海地區的命運。它在隋、唐之間先是被打、被安撫，終於在七〇年代隨著吐蕃的崛起而崩解，殘眾被安置在涼州、鄯州一帶，融入了西北漢地與吐谷渾血統混合的社會。今天青海、甘肅一帶的土族，部分即為其後裔。
impactEn:
The result of this campaign reached well beyond the field of battle. For the Tuyuhun, 584 was the first time they were struck hard enough to send the khan himself into flight; named princes were taken, a great part of the people were scattered back across the pastures, and the collaboration between the tribes, which had rested on the division of plunder, was torn apart. Power concentrated in a few strong groups, and the state turned from its height to decline. Though it could gather an army again on the Qinghai road, it would never again stand up to Sui or Tang face to face, and was finally swallowed by Tibet.

For Sui and for the Western Regions, the campaign was a demonstration of frontier policy that worked: the merchants and military stores of the Hexi Corridor moved in safety, the transit dues and tribute of the Qinghai road acquired a predictable order, and Sui military might was carried clearly to the West for the first time, forcing the Western Turks and the Gaochang region to reassess the weight of the new dynasty. That the Sui dare later open several lines in the north-west in the same years of the Daye era and set up four commanderies was built on the results won in the Kaihuang years. At the level of technique, the campaign also laid the chronic weakness of the northern frontier armies bare: the longer the supply line, the harder it was to answer the scorched-earth withdrawal of a nomadic state, and the Sui generals of the early Tang would handle the problem far more carefully.

In the longer term, the fate of the Tuyuhun was the fate of the whole Qinghai region. Struck and then pacified by Sui and Tang in turn, it finally collapsed with the rise of Tibet in the seventh century, its survivors settled around Liangzhou and Shanzhou, and were absorbed into a mixed society of Han and Tuyuhun blood in the north-west. The Tu people of Qinghai and Gansu today descend in part from them.
result:
開皇四年的結局，簡單說是：隋軍在會戰中大勝，國未亡。吐谷渾傾力來犯的騎兵在鄯州以西的接觸中被壓垮，兵眾潰散於青海湖東南的草原與河谷，伏允與其兄弟逃入山中，僅以身免；名王與相當數量的部眾被俘、降，隋軍在追擊途中取得明確的戰果。隋朝沒能追到最後——遠征的糧秣與援軍都到不了位，班師的時候還要在積石山刻石記功，把這場勝利定為一場有邊界的懲罰。

從長期看，吐谷渾仍然是青海的主人。它表面向隋稱臣，重新遣使貢方物，卻始終不肯放棄白蘭道與青海道的控制權；隋朝也明白這一點，所以在往後二十多年裡，政策從武力改回羈縻，直到大業年間才有第二次大規模出手。第二次出手的結果更具決定性：克曼頭、赤水，置鄯善、且末、西海、河源四郡，把郡縣正式立到吐谷渾的土地上——然而四郡很快失陷，伏允在青海復國，隋朝在西北的經營為時不長即告中止。吐谷渾這個政權最終不是亡於隋，也不是亡於唐，而是亡於六六三年吐蕃的攻滅；此後它的舊地與舊民，成為唐蕃之間長期角力的舞臺。
resultEn:
The outcome of the fourth year of Kaihuang can be put briefly: the Sui won the battle of arms, and the state survived. The Tuyuhun horsemen who had thrown everything into the attack were crushed in the contact west of Shanzhou, and the host broke up over the pastures and valleys south-east of Qinghai Lake; Fuyun and his brothers fled into the mountains and escaped with their lives alone. Named princes and a considerable number of the people were captured or surrendered, and the Sui took an unambiguous prize in the pursuit. But the Sui could not follow to the end, for the grain and the reinforcements of so long a march could not reach the front, and on the way home they had to carve the record into stone at Jishi Mountain, fixing the victory as a punitive stroke with clear limits.

In the long run the Tuyuhun remained masters of Qinghai. They pretended once more to be Sui vassals and sent envoys with tribute, yet never gave up their control of the Bailan route and the Qinghai road. The Sui understood this too, so for more than twenty years the policy swung back from force to pacification, and there was no second large campaign until the years of the Daye era. That second stroke was more decisive: Mantou and Chishui were taken, and the four commanderies of Shanshan, Qiemo, Xihai and Heyuan were formally planted on Tuyuhun soil. Yet the four were quickly lost, Fuyun restored his kingdom at Qinghai, and the Sui work in the north-west was called off before long. The Tuyuhun polity was not destroyed by Sui, nor by Tang, but by the Tibetan conquest of 663; its old lands and its old people afterwards became the stage of the long struggle between Tang and Tibet.
